faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the susceptibility of the tuberculosis bacteria (MTB complex) to cycloserine.

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex done?
faqs.answer: • This test is primarily done to assess the drug susceptibility of tuberculosis bacteria. • To guide the selection of appropriate medications for tuberculosis treatment • To monitor the effectiveness of ongoing tuberculosis treatment • To identify drug-resistant strains of tuberculosis

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is typically recommended when a person has • A suspected or confirmed diagnosis of tuberculosis • An inadequate response to previous tuberculosis treatment • Symptoms suggestive of drug-resistant tuberculosis • A history of exposure to drug-resistant tuberculosis

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex are abnormal?
faqs.answer: The test provides information about the susceptibility of tuberculosis bacteria to cycloserine. Abnormal results may suggest drug resistance.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: During this test, a sputum or other appropriate specimen will be collected to be sent to a laboratory for testing for drug susceptibility.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: • GeneXpert MTB/RIF assay: Detects the presence of tuberculosis bacteria and determines rifampicin resistance • Culture and sensitivity testing: Helps identify tuberculosis bacteria and assess their susceptibility to various drugs • Chest X-ray: Provides an image of the lungs to evaluate tuberculosis-related changes

faqs.question: What is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Cycloserine Drug by Conventional LJ – Pure Growth of MTB Complex also known as?
faqs.answer: MTB complex drug susceptibility testing for cycloserine by conventional LJ culture

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease caused by the bacteria Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. TB spreads through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Early detection and appropriate treatment are crucial to prevent its spread and manage the disease effectively.
